about: Knowledge Club is a collaborative learning initiative dedicated to driving continuous growth, innovation, and cross-functional knowledge sharing. Through our weekly Tech Tuesday sessions, members dive into emerging technologies, industry best practices, and practical use cases, all while refining their leadership, presentation, and communication skills.
mission: Our goal is to build a culture of curiosity and learning from one another. By encouraging collaboration, Knowledge Club helps team members share their expertise, stay ahead of tech trends, and build a more connected, skilled community across the organization.

programs.name: Tech Tuesdays
programs.description: In Tech Tuesdays, a speaker explains a technical topic of their choice in depth. Sessions run in two formats, 30 minutes and 60 minutes, and both include a Q&A.

programs.name: DECODE-iT
programs.description: DECODE-iT brings multiple speakers (minimum 4) into one session. Each speaker gets 10 to 15 minutes (maximum 15) to explain their chosen topic as simply and clearly as possible.
